subject: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence, SLA & owner mapping
messages:
From: Audits Team <security@finsecure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T10:15:00Z
Subject: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence, SLA & owner mapping

Hi Kimberly,

As part of FinSecure's onboarding SOC 2 scoping, we need a compact evidence packet covering your vulnerability management program. At minimum can you provide: 

- Proof of most recent authenticated/full network and dependency scans (sample report is fine).
- Scan cadence (how often full vs incremental scans run).
- SLA for CVE remediation by severity (e.g., critical/high/medium) and any escalation workflow.
- A named owner roster for CVE triage/patching and the process for exceptions/compensating controls.

Please attach the sample report and any owner mapping spreadsheets. We are aiming to close the audit checklist by next week; if you can respond by EOD 2027-06-08 with what you have that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez (on behalf of FinSecure Audit Team)
security@finsecure.com

--
FinSecure: Compliance & Audit

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Audits Team <security@finsecure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence, SLA & owner mapping

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the checklist — I'm attaching a compact evidence packet that should hit the bulleted items: 'redwood-scan-20270601-summary.pdf' (sanitized scan output + executive summary) and 'cve-commit-log-20270601.csv' (export of remediation tickets and staged closure dates).

Quick clarifications we included in the packet: 
- Scan cadence: full authenticated host + dependency scan runs weekly in our staging environment; incremental/CI-integrated checks run on every critical dep release (daily). Production risk scans (credentials-limited) run nightly for high/critical detection.
- SLA policy: Critical CVEs targeted for mitigation within 7 days of validated exploitability; High within 30 days; Medium/Low per risk-based triage (45-90 days). Where a technical exception is necessary, we document compensating controls and enter a 30-day exception review with required mitigations and monitoring.
- Owner mapping: SRE owns host-level remediation and rollback playbooks; App teams own dependency upgrades. I flagged owners inline in the CSV.

Ben & Laura, can you please coordinate a signed attestation for the SLA table (SOC 2 / SIG friendly) — I put a DocuSign link in the Drive folder for a short attestation we can sign and return to FinSecure.

Alex — if you want more granular logs or a longer retention export, let us know and we can provide a scoped bundle.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Trust (Security Programs)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-scan-20270601-summary.pdf, cve-commit-log-20270601.csv

--

Alex — following up with owner confirmations and an explicit timeline: 

- SRE (host remediation, emergency rollback): Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com) — primary contact for critical CVEs and emergency patch windows.
- Platform Security (triage & exploit validation): Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.example.com) — validates exploitability and coordinates backporting vs mitigation.
- App Engineering (dependency upgrades): Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.example.com) and Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.example.com) — owners for application-level CVE remediation.

Commitment summary: for any item scored as Critical by Platform Security, we commit to emergency remediation within 7 days or, if mitigation/rollback is required, to an interim compensating control (network ACL, WAF rule) within 72 hours and a remediation plan within 7 days. High severity will be targeted within 30 calendar days with weekly progress updates until closure.

Ben — please route the DocuSign attestation to Alex using the short-form SOC2 wording; Kimberly has uploaded the supporting artifacts to the Drive link provided.

Alex — if FinSecure needs a signed CSV with the owner roster attached to the attestation, we can add it to the envelope. Please confirm and Ben will finish the envelope.
